MarginTop.helper: Space outside the section, above it.

PaddingTop.helper: Space inside the section, above the content.

PaddingBottom.helper: Space inside the section, below the content.

MarginBottom.helper: Space outside the section, below it.

AutoForward.rightLabel: Automatically advance one banner every 5 seconds
AutoForward.helper: Visitors get a Pause/Play button, and rotation pauses while a banner control has keyboard focus. It starts paused for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

PauseOnHover.rightLabel: Pause rotation while the pointer is over the banner
PauseOnHover.helper: Applies only when Auto-Forward is on. Rotation continues when the pointer leaves the banner.

ShowNavigation.helper: Adds left and right buttons over the banner edges. Buttons are hidden automatically when there is only one banner.

Theme.helper: Choose the look of the banner frame, buttons, and Show all link. Default (current) inherits your site's own styles. HoverInfo shows the banner Name as a caption on hover. Each theme can also use its own banner markup in banners/{theme}.cshtml.
